description: Source code for managing schema version upgrades in PyTorch, including registration, deregistration, and application of upgraders for JSON artifacts.
external_files: json library used for JSON manipulation

classes.name: Upgrader
classes.description: Represents a JSON schema upgrader with a keypath and upgrade function.

methods.name: getUpgrader
methods.description: Retrieves registered upgraders for a specific version.

methods.name: getFieldByKeypath
methods.description: Extracts a nested JSON field based on a keypath.

methods.name: setFieldByKeypath
methods.description: Sets a nested JSON field based on a keypath.

methods.name: registerUpgrader
methods.description: Registers a new upgrader for a specific version and keypath.

methods.name: deregisterUpgrader
methods.description: Removes a registered upgrader for a specific version and keypath.

methods.name: throwUpgraderError
methods.description: Throws an error with detailed upgrader failure information.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades a JSON artifact to a target schema version using registered upgraders.
